Therefore it seems in my humble opinion that it is somewhat like what is explained in the fifth tikkun of the latter Tikkunim — in the discourse Kam Rabbi Shimon al raglov, etc.: "avid bigin Shechinata de-ihi be-galusa — and if she is in impurity — behold father and mother — which are Chochmah and Binah — can make a release — and if she has taken a vow from the side of father and mother and they are not willing — I shall ascend to the One of whom it is said: 'for a matter that is wondrous from you' — of whom it is said: 'in what is too wondrous for you do not inquire' — who can dissolve the vow," etc. This being the aspect of what is explained in the discourse Pasach Rabbi Shimon — that there are those who fell so greatly in their sleep — until they must be awakened through stories of ancient times, etc. — which is the aspect of the tikkun of Atik — the aspect of the Zaken [elder], etc. And in the end he merited to find the daughter of the King — and take her out — and return her to her root and her place in peace. And see in the Introduction to the Sipuray Maasiyos — there are matters that are explained there somewhat more.

 
 Story 2 · סימן ב' — מִמֶּלֶךְ וְקֵיסָר

The King and the Emperor

 We have not heard any allusion or explanation regarding this story. But the letters stand out and join together by themselves. For it is understood entirely clearly that it speaks of the secret of the union of the Tzaddik and the Knesses Yisrael — which is the secret of the building of Yerushalayim and the redemption of Israel. And how the Shechinah, as it were, is bound to Israel with a strong bond and great attachment — and shall never be separated from them forever and ever. And all the causes that passed over the emperor's daughter — and over the groom who is the King's son — and all in order to separate, G-d forbid, the bond between them. And she — in the greatness of her wisdom and righteousness — passed through all of it — and conducted herself with each one according to his aspect. For the bandits and murderers she killed completely — and all with great wisdom as is explained within the ma'amar — and she escaped from the merchant's son and from the king — and through this great sufferings passed over them — for they were expelled from their places. And how she killed from a distance through the burning glass that melts the ice — that is the old king's son — (and presumably he was from the aspect of the wicked kingship, as is understood) — and burned his brain until he fell through this into the sea waters. And through this the matter was brought around — until they all gathered — and then she returned to the king his daughters of ministers — and he returned to his country and his kingdom. And to the merchant's son she returned his ship with his merchandise — with profit of great wealth many times over — more than what he had — for already there was also all the exceedingly great wealth she had taken from the bandits. And to the King's son — who is her true groom — she said: let us go and travel — and they returned to their home, etc. And certainly in every matter and every matter — and in every word and word — of these stories — there are great and supernal secrets. And everything relates to the secret of the world of Tikkun and the ingathering of the exiles to Eretz Yisrael — and the revelation of the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael through the King Mashiach — and the building of the cities of Yehudah and Israel — an everlasting building. (May it be His will that we merit.)

 
 Story 3 · סימן ג' — מַעֲשֶׂה מֵחָכָם וְכוּ'

The Wise Man

 It is explained within the ma'amar that the matters are sealed and closed — except for the allusions that our Rebbe, may his memory be for blessing, revealed himself. But even so it is explained that it speaks of the secret of the world of Tikkun — and the nullification of the klippos and the Sitra Achra — the aspect of: "and the spirit of impurity I will cause to pass from the land." And regarding the wondrous tree — whose every branch and fruit and leaf has a special property — this one is suited for children — and this for healing, etc. And afterwards it alludes that there is a tree — that if it were watered — there would remain nothing of the demons at all. And how there was an earthquake — and the tree was watered entirely — and not a single one of them remained — and they became as if they had never been.

 (See Yechezkel 47:) "and behold water flowing from beneath the threshold of the house", etc., "and behold on the bank of the river — a very many tree on one side and the other," etc. — "and on the river on its bank — on one side and the other — shall grow every tree for food — its leaf shall not wither and its fruit shall not end — each month it shall bear first fruit — for its waters flow from the sanctuary — and its fruit shall be for food and its leaf for healing." See Rashi who wrote: our Sages explained — to open the mouths of the mute — and the mouths of the barren — and its meaning is the language of healing, etc. — this being the aspect of the aforementioned tree.

And if this tree itself is the same tree — that if it were watered there would remain nothing of the demons at all — as seems clear within the ma'amar — then the sun's complaint before the moon regarding this tree — that she shines upon it and dries it out — and similarly what the moon replied to her — that she worries the worry of others — but she worries her own worry and pain — in that the demons draw from her feet and therefore she has no strength in her feet, etc. — and in truth: if this tree had been watered — there would remain none of them at all — and there would automatically be healing also for the moon for her pain. It follows that in the secret of the world of Tikkun — everything will be rectified, as stated above. And perhaps this is the matter of: "and in his Torah he meditates day and night" — the aspect of the joining of day and night in Torah — the aspect of the place where day and night gather together — as is explained within the ma'amar — and: "and he shall be like a tree planted by streams of water" — the aspect of the aforementioned tree. And this is what the Holy One Blessed be He warned Yehoshua at the beginning of the entry into Eretz Yisrael: "the book of Torah shall not depart from your mouth — and you shall meditate in it day and night." And in the battle of Giv'on he said: "sun, stand still at Giv'on — and moon in the valley of Ayalon," etc. And all of this needs further explanation. And this is the aspect of: "sun and moon stood in their lofty place," etc. — see Rashi [Chavakuk 3]. And this is the aspect of: "the mountain of Tzion — the far reaches of the north," etc. — "for behold — the kings assembled," etc. — which are the aspects of the sun and the moon — of whom it is said: "and to rule by day and by night," etc. — and as is understood also in the holy Zohar. And therefore there is the primary intercalation of years and sanctification of the new month.

 
 Story 4 · סימן ד' — מַעֲשֶׂה נִסִּים

 And there in the allusions — afterwards the verse is brought: "and I — I have anointed My king upon Tzion My holy mountain," etc. — for there are included all the portions of the world, etc. And there is the primary rectification of the holy counsel. And see also below in Siman 6 — in the allusions — regarding the matter of: "behold Tzion — city of our appointed times," etc. And this is the aspect of: "for behold the stone," etc., "upon one stone — seven eyes," etc. — see Rashi [Zechariyah 3] — for there is the totality of all seven climates — as is understood also from the words of our Sages. (And see Sha'ar HaChatzair, chapter 41, siman 65.) And there they offer upon the fire of the altar sacrifices — whose majority are only from ox and sheep — for goats are also included in sheep — as our Sages said — and as Rashi explained in Parshas Bo on the verse: "from the sheep or from the goats," etc. And through this the sins are atoned — and one is saved from the fire of Gehinnom and the like — as our Sages said [Bamidbar Rabbah, Pekudai, chapter 51].

Story 5 · סימן ה' — מַעֲשֶׂה בְּמֶלֶךְ שֶׁלֹּא הָיָה לוֹ בָּנִים

 The King Who Had No Children

 They say regarding this story — that there was an implication from the words of our Rebbe, may his memory be for blessing, that there is in it a secret of the Name of Forty-Two, etc. — as is explained elsewhere. And see in Zohar Chadash [at the end of Parshas Ki Savo] in the Likkutim: "and because of this Israel did not enter the land until they acquired thirty additional journeys — and the secret of the Name of Forty-Two was completed," etc. — see there. And also what is explained here — about the King's son who became a leper — and afterwards was healed — and the leprosy dried up — and all the skin peeled from him — and then it was revealed and seen that he is entirely made of precious stones — and he had all the properties of all the precious stones. We find something similar regarding the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael. As our Sages said regarding the verse: "for you shall come to the land of Kena'an — and I shall place the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession" — and as Rashi explained there — that through this Israel found treasuries of gold that the Emorites had hidden in the walls of their houses. And see in the Midrash — where our Sages expounded this verse regarding the destruction of the Bais HaMikdash. And it concludes there: "and they shall take other stones" — as it is written: "behold I lay in Tzion a stone — a tested stone — a precious cornerstone," etc. And there was the Even HaShetiyah — in which were included all twelve stones of Yaakov — which are the aspect of the twelve tribes — which had the properties of all the precious stones. This being the aspect of the twelve stones of the Choshen — as is brought. And our Sages expounded [Bereishis Rabbah, chapter 16]: shem ha-bdolach ve-even ha-shoham [the name of the crystal and the onyx stone] — regarding Eretz Yisrael.

Story 6 · סימן ו' — מַעֲשֶׂה בְּמֶלֶךְ וְחָכָם

 The King and the Wise Man

 In Eretz Yisrael there were great warriors — as is explicit in many verses and in the words of our Sages — and it is written: "behold — the bed of Shlomoh — sixty warriors around it," etc. And also it is written: "for He founded it upon the seas," etc. — and it is written: "Yerushalayim — mountains surround it," etc. And also there is the primary truth — as stated above many times. And also there is the primary humility — as it is written: "and the humble shall inherit the land," etc. And also the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael is in the aspect of the King — whose image is found with no king — for He is hidden from human beings, etc. — and He is far from the people of His province. As is understood in the holy Zohar [Parshas Lech, page 78] — regarding Avraham our father — who attained all the sides of the inhabited world — and knew the forces appointed over them — and when he arrived at the innermost central point of the inhabited world — which is the aspect of the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — he weighed with his scales, etc. — and he saw that the supernal force above it has no measure — it is deep and hidden, etc. — the powerful ones of the deep — and he was unable to stand in it, etc. — see there. And also in the allusions at the end of the story — the verse is brought: "behold Tzion — city of our appointed times."

Story 7 · סימן ז' — מַעֲשֶׂה בְּמֶלֶךְ שֶׁכָּבַשׁ וְכוּ'

 The King Who Conquered

 See in Midrash Shocher Tov [Mishlei 30]: "the shemamis [gecko] — taken by hands — this is the kingdom", etc., "and it is in the palaces of the king — that destroyed the sanctuary of the King of kings of kings — the Holy One Blessed be He. And there: 'the shemamis,' etc. — this is Amalek," etc. And it is automatically understood that the fly [zevuv] is the aspect of the weak ones among Israel — whom the klippah of Esav and Amalek pursues — only the page on which the statutes of Israel are written — which is the holy Torah — protects them — as our Sages said: "as long as the voice — the voice of Yaakov," etc. And they said about: "because they abandoned My Torah — if only they had abandoned Me — and kept My Torah," etc. And see in the allusions at the end of the story — there is brought the matter of: "Hashem — how many are my oppressors," etc. — which is directed also to the matter of the distress of all Israel and their exile, etc. And there: "and He answered me from His holy mountain — Selah." And our Sages expounded: "at the time that Your sanctuary was built — You would answer our prayers — and even now it is a mountain — as it is said: 'and He answered me from His holy mountain — Selah.'"

Story 8 · סימן ח' — מַעֲשֶׂה בְּרַב וְכוּ'

 The primary perfection of Torah and prayer and all service of Hashem is in Eretz Yisrael — as stated above many times. For Eretz Yisrael is called Eretz HaChayyim — for there the service is with the vitality of holiness — the aspect of: "wisdom gives life." For there is the aspect of mochin d'gadlus — the aspect of the great luminary. And this is the aspect of: "and it shall be when He brings you", etc., "to the land", etc., "to give you great and good cities," etc. And similarly in Parshas Ekev: "hear, O Israel — you are crossing", etc., "great cities," etc. And our Sages said: "even the great river — the Euphrates river — because it is mentioned together with Eretz Yisrael — it is called great," etc.

 But Eretz Yisrael is one of three things given through suffering — and the primary of the suffering is through the wicked ones who prevent — the spreaders of slander about the land — as is explained in the discourse of the nine tikkunim — Likutay Moharan Kama, Siman 20. For this is the aspect of all the obstacles that passed over the son of the Rav. For the Tzaddik is the aspect of one with the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — the aspect of: "the righteous shall inherit the land" — and as it is written: "and the earth stands forever" — and Rashi explained: "all the righteous of Israel are called 'earth' — as it is written: 'and you shall be to Me a land of desire.'" And this is the aspect of: "and the great house" — and our Sages expounded: "the house in which Torah and prayer are made great — specifically made great." For there the Torah and prayer are in the aspect of mochin d'gadlus. And therefore there the service is in fullness — without any deficiency — as it is written: "it lacks nothing" — the aspect of: "you acquired knowledge — what do you lack?" And this is what is brought in the holy Zohar: "sheleimo lo ishtakach ela be-ar'a kaddisha" — [fullness is not found except in the holy land].

 
 Story 9 · סימן ט' — מַעֲשֶׂה מֵחָכָם וָתָם

The Wise Man and the Simple Man

 Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of simplicity — as it is written: "for the upright shall dwell in the land — and the wholehearted shall remain in it." And Avraham our father, may peace be upon him — who was the first to the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael — it is said of him: "walk before Me and be wholehearted." And similarly Yaakov our father, may peace be upon him — who was the primary to the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael — as it is written: "and He established it for Yaakov as a statute," etc., "to you I will give the land of Kena'an" — it is said of him: "and Yaakov was a wholehearted man." And the general Knesses Yisrael is called: "my dove — my wholehearted one." And it is written in Parshas Shoftim: "for you are coming to the land," etc., "you shall be wholehearted with Hashem your G-d." And because of the simplicity one merits there to the trait of contentment in food and drink and clothing — this being the aspect of: "the land in which you shall eat bread — not in poverty" — meaning: it is not because of poverty that they eat only bread there — only that in the bread they taste all manner of delicacies — "it lacks nothing" — meaning: also clothing and similar things — for one garment will suffice for them for everything — as is also brought in the book Sha'ar HaChatzair — that this verse is directed at the trait of contentment. And there one merits to always be in joy and delight — as stated above many times. And to delight in the service of Hashem in everything one does in the service of Hashem — each one according to his aspect. This being the aspect of: "dwell in the land — and tend to faithfulness — and delight in Hashem," etc. — and it is written: "and the humble shall inherit the land — and they shall delight in the abundance of peace."

 And in truth — there is the primary perfection of wisdom — for: "there is no wisdom like the wisdom of Eretz Yisrael." And even so they conduct themselves in simplicity. For in truth this itself is the primary wisdom — to walk in simplicity — and as is explained elsewhere. And through this they merit all good — as it is written: "He will not withhold good from those who walk in wholeness" — and it is written: "and the wholehearted shall inherit good." And there one merits complete faith — to believe in the King of the world — even though He is very hidden and concealed — and no thought can grasp Him at all — even so — everything is conducted through Him, blessed be He — and through His individual Providence — even over the lowly. And in particular in Eretz Yisrael — wherein He, blessed be He, seeks it always — "the eyes of Hashem your G-d are upon it," etc. This being the aspect of: "one who dwells in Eretz Yisrael — it is as though he has a G-d — which is not so outside the land — which is under the authority of the seventy ministers — even though all of them are under His sovereignty, blessed be He — even so — they can err, G-d forbid — and deny, G-d forbid, the Providence of the King of the world, blessed be He — and as though the ministers themselves have some power and dominion." This being the aspect of: "and you shall arise and go up," etc., "you shall not deviate," etc.

This being the aspect of what one must believe — that there are complete Tzaddikim who know how to use the holy Names in great holiness at the time of necessity — and through this nullify all the power of the other sides and the klippos, G-d forbid. For even though the truth is that one must believe only in the holy faith — and that there is no power for any thing in the world against His will, blessed be He — for: "there is none other than Him." Even so one must know and believe that there are also other sides, G-d forbid — which are not seen either by most people — and are not attained through human intellect. And even so there are many occurrences in the world that the wicked and the sorcerers make through names of impurity. This being the aspect of what our Sages said: "why are they called mekashfim [sorcerers]?", etc. And the Sanhedrin were required to learn also the deeds of sorcery in order to understand and to rule. And there in Eretz Yisrael one merits to know and distinguish between the light and the darkness — meaning: between the deeds and actions that are done through names of impurity and sorcery and the like — which are truly the aspect of darkness — and between the deeds and actions that are done through the prayers of the true Tzaddikim who know how to concentrate on the holy Names and the like — in great holiness. And as is explained in Likutay Moharan Kama, Siman 234. And the primary use of the holy Names in holiness is in Eretz Yisrael — as it is written: "in every place where I cause My Name to be remembered," etc.

 And in truth — those denials of the false wise men — who deny everything — both the King and the Baal Shem — and similarly also the evil spirits, G-d forbid — which are the other sides — all of this flows from the other sides themselves — for only they twist their hearts so greatly — until they deny everything — and in the end they themselves take vengeance on them — the aspect of: "the death of the wicked is evil" — until they throw them into literal filth and mire — and afflict them with harsh afflictions. And there too they twist their hearts so greatly — until they still do not return from their evil view — the aspect of: "the wicked — even at the entrance of Gehinnom — do not repent." And they have no remedy except through the true Tzaddikim — the aspect of the Baal Shem — as is explained within the ma'amar — for only he can take them out from the filth and mire — and nullify all those other sides in complete nullification — like dust of the earth. And then the aforementioned wise men too return and acknowledge and repent to the truth.

 
 Story 10 · סימן י' — מַעֲשֶׂה מִבֶּרְגִּיר

The Shepherd

 It is explained in the allusions at the end of the story that it speaks of the secret of the redemption, etc. And one can say that the general community of Israel is also in the aspect of the shepherd's son — for the Patriarchs are called mountains — as our Sages expounded: "leaping over the mountains — in the merit of the fathers," etc. And it is written: "hear, O mountains," etc. — "ailin Avahan" — and Eretz Yisrael — generally and in particular — Yerushalayim — are called the mountain of Hashem — and it is written: "Yerushalayim — mountains surround it" — and it is written: "to Hashem belongs the earth and its fullness," etc., "for He founded it upon the seas — and upon the rivers He established it — who shall ascend the mountain of Hashem?" And our Sages said that Eretz Yisrael rests upon seven seas and upon rivers, etc. — the aspect of the waters as is explained within the ma'amar. And we find in the praise of Eretz Yisrael all the aforementioned waters — as it is written: "hewn cisterns," etc. — and it is written: "a land of streams of water — springs and depths," etc. — and it is written: "He places the desert into a pool of water" — see Targum — and it is written: "for He founded it upon the seas — and upon the rivers He established it." And our Sages said [Shabbos 109a]: "all the waters are judged like a mikveh — as it is said: 'and to the gathering of waters He called seas,'" etc.

 And the Holy One Blessed be He bound Himself to our fathers and to us with a true bond — and promised us that the bond would be strong and firm forever and ever — and that He would not exchange us for another nation — and He gave us holy signs of how to maintain this bond also in the days of our affliction and our exiles — until: "in its time I will hasten it." And behold — the adversaries prevail so greatly, G-d forbid — until in every generation they stand against us to destroy us utterly, G-d forbid. And: "the lovingkindnesses of Hashem — for we have not been consumed completely," G-d forbid — only it was exchanged for us through the exiles and the subjugation of the kingdoms. And the Sitra Achra lurks at every moment to sever, G-d forbid, the holy bond between the Holy One Blessed be He and His people — and sometimes it overpowers so greatly — until some despair enters even in the heart of Israel — because of the length of the exiles, etc. — until through this we ourselves almost hand over the holy signs to others, G-d forbid. But: "and You, Hashem, are exalted forever" — and His hand is uppermost always — and in the end the Holy One Blessed be He will complete His own — and all the descents will be transformed into great ascents — until everything will be rectified — as is explained within the ma'amar.

Story 11 · סימן י"א — מַעֲשֶׂה מִבֶּן מֶלֶךְ וּבֶן שִׁפְחָה שֶׁנֶּחֱלְפוּ

 The Prince and the Maidservant's Son Who Were Exchanged

 It is explained in Likutay Halachos — Laws of Morning Blessings — that what happened from the day the world was created — the coming of the serpent who seduced Chavah — and what the serpent did to Chavah — and what Kayin did to Hevel — and Nimrod who threw Avraham into the fiery furnace — and Yishmael who wanted to kill Yitzchak — and Esav who wanted to kill Yaakov, etc. — all of this is in the secret of the aforementioned exchanges. And it is automatically understood that this too is the secret of what Eretz Yisrael was initially in the hands of Kena'an. And similarly what, in our many sins, Eretz Yisrael was subsequently destroyed — and Israel was exiled from within it among the nations. And in particular according to what is explained above in the name of Megaleh Amukos — that when Israel is in Eretz Yisrael they are in the aspect of banim [children] — and in the Diaspora they are in the aspect of servants, etc. Meaning: that also in holiness they themselves are only in the aspect of a holy servant — who does not have permission to search in the treasuries of the King — except for what he reveals to him through the revealed — and in addition in corporeality they are under the authority and dominion of the wicked servant — the aspect of: "servants ruled over us," etc. Until through this they fall in their mind and despair, G-d forbid, from the level of their sanctity — until there are those who come through this to what they come — the aspect of: "and they mingled among the nations," etc. — and as is explained within the ma'amar also regarding the King's son — that through his being expelled from his place, etc., he came to what he came to, G-d forbid. But even so: "and You, Hashem, are exalted forever" — for in the end everything will be rectified — as is explained within the ma'amar.

And it is also explained above that Eretz Yisrael is from the aspect of Gan Eden. And similarly it is explained in the words of our Sages that the exile of Israel from Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of one thing with the expulsion of the first man from Gan Eden. And the primary tikkun is through Shabbos — which is the aspect of the King who had peace in his days. And therefore our Sages said: "Yerushalayim was destroyed only because they desecrated Shabbos in it." And similarly: "had Israel kept two Shabbosos — they would immediately be redeemed" — (and see in the commentators the reason for two Shabbosos specifically, etc.) And see in the Zohar [Terumah 138] — explained regarding the song that the cows of Bashan sang at the time that they carried the Ark to Beis Shemesh — and regarding the matter of Shabbos being the aspect of the King whose peace is His, etc. — and regarding the matter of there being two aspects of Shabbos, etc. — and perhaps this is the secret of the two Shabbosos that our Sages said.

 And also Yerushalayim is the aspect of the throne of Hashem — as it is written: "at that time they shall call Yerushalayim the throne of Hashem," etc. And in particular the Bais HaMikdash — of which it is said: "a throne of glory — exalted from the beginning — the place of our sanctuary." And there is the primary tikkun of the Shechinah — the aspect of the bed, the table, the chair, the menorah — as is explained in the holy Zohar. And there is the primary perfection of the wondrous melody and song — the aspect of the song that the Levites would say in the Bais HaMikdash. And there is the primary secret of intercalation and sanctification of the new month — which is the aspect of the renewal of the moon. And there is the primary tikkun of Malchus and its ascent to its place and its root — the aspect of: "Hashem shall reign forever — your G-d, O Tzion," etc. — and it is said: "and saviors shall ascend on Mount Tzion," etc., "and the kingdom shall be Hashem's" — and it is said: "for Hashem of hosts reigns on Mount Tzion and in Yerushalayim," etc. — and it is said: "and My servant Dovid shall be king over them" — and it is said: "and they shall seek Hashem their G-d — and Dovid their king."

 
 Story 12 · סימן י"ב — מַעֲשֶׂה מֵהַבַּעַל תְּפִלָּה

The Master of Prayer

 See in the allusions at the end of the story: "the utterance of Hashem — whose fire is in Tzion — and whose furnace is in Yerushalayim." And also there is the root of all the opinions of all the sects explained within the ma'amar — which were subsequently rectified through the King with his men. For in holiness there is for every opinion of every book and sect a great root — and as is explained in Likutay Halachos, Laws of Prayer — all of this we find in the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael and Yerushalayim, etc. For our Sages said: "ten sanctities did Eretz Yisrael sanctify — and they correspond to the aspect of the ten qualities — the ten matters of the aspect of the world of Tikkun."

 The sect that said the primary purpose is honor — they were subsequently rectified through the old King himself — whom they found sitting in a field crowned with a crown — and it pleased them — for he is greatly honored. This flows from the fact that in its root — honor is truly a great thing — and all that the Holy One Blessed be He created — He created only for His glory — and all the ten utterances were only for the sake of the revelation of His glory, blessed be He. And the primary revelation of His glory, blessed be He, is in Eretz Yisrael — the aspect of: "the whole earth is full of His glory." And in Yerushalayim it is said: "glorious things are spoken of you," etc. And the primary is in the Bais HaMikdash — as it is said: "and the glory of Hashem filled the house" — and it is said: "and in His sanctuary — all of it says 'glory'" — and it is said: "lift up your heads, O gates," etc., "and the King of glory shall enter," etc. — and it is said: "for Hashem has built Tzion — He appeared in His glory" — and this: "for Hashem of hosts reigns on Mount Tzion and in Yerushalayim — and before His elders is glory" — and it is said: "to cause the glory to dwell in our land." And in truth — even at the time of the exiles and the destruction — even so the holy glory stands in its place — the aspect of: "blessed is the Name of the glory of His kingdom forever and ever." And our Sages said: "for now you shall go out from the city — and dwell in the field" — veshachanti [and I will dwell] is written — "even though you are exiles in the field — My Shechinah has not moved from you," etc. And it is written: "Tzion shall be plowed as a field," etc. — and our Sages said: "the Shechinah has never moved from there," etc. This being the aspect of what they found the old King sitting in a field crowned with a crown, etc. — this being the aspect of what our Sages said: "'and I will make your sanctuaries desolate' — even when they are desolate their sanctity is upon them," etc. And because honor is such a great thing — one must be very careful not to be a pursuer of honor — not to use the scepter of the King, G-d forbid — but on the contrary — to diminish one's own honor and to increase the honor of G-d. And then specifically one merits true holy honor — the aspect of: "those who honor Me I will honor."

The sect that said the primary purpose is killing, etc. — and afterwards they merited to receive the Queen to reign over them — because they found her sitting in a sea of blood that was made from her tears. This flows in its root from the trait of holy judgment and might — the aspect of the four death penalties of the court that were practiced in Eretz Yisrael — and regarding the tribe of Levi it is said: "who says of his father and his mother: I have not seen him," etc. And our Sages said in the holy Zohar [Bereishis 151]: "Yerushalayim — she is judgment — and upon judgment she stands." And this is the aspect of the Queen — the aspect of: "dina de-malchusa dina" [the law of the kingdom is law]. And this is what is written [Yeshayahu 1]: "righteousness lodged in her — now murderers" — as stated above. And therefore in truth the holy Malchus is the aspect of: "techeles de-achli kola ve-shatzei kola" [the tekheles that consumes everything and destroys everything] — that makes an end and a termination and a destruction to all the wicked, etc. — that one must avenge them and eradicate the evil from within the land — as is brought in the discourse La-Shemesh — Likutay Moharan Kama, Siman 49. And this is the aspect of: "a land that devours its inhabitants" — as is brought in Sha'ar HaChatzair, Siman 71. And even so our Sages said [Sanhedrin 46]: "if thus G-d is troubled over the blood of the wicked," etc. And it is said: "a voice is heard in Ramah," etc., "Rachel weeping for her children," etc. This being the aspect of the tears that the Queen wept over the loss of the King, etc., and his men — until a sea of blood was made, as stated above.

 The sect that said it is fitting to crown one who has abundant food and sustenance — and is nourished only from fine foods, etc. — they subsequently merited to receive upon them as king the infant who sat in a sea of milk — who was the son of the daughter of the Queen. This flows from the fact that in truth a person must be careful in his eating — not to have coarse food that confuses the mind — for the mind is according to the food — as is explained in Likutay Moharan Kama, Siman 61 — the discourse of Rabbi Shimon. And also not to be in his eating in the aspect of the food of animals — as Esav said: "pour into me now," etc. — and as our Sages expounded. But rather that the food should be in the aspect of human food — the aspect of: "the righteous man eats to satisfy his soul" — one eats little and is blessed within — this being the aspect of: "and you shall eat your bread to satisfaction," etc. — said in the blessing of Eretz Yisrael. For there the eating is in holiness — in the aspect of the eating of man — as stated above — and as is brought in Sha'ar HaChatzair. And there is the aspect of contentment in matters of eating — as it is written: "the land in which you shall eat bread — not in poverty," etc. — and as is brought. And this is the aspect of [Mishlei 27]: "and sufficient milk of goats for your food — for the food of your household," etc. — and our Sages said: "the Torah taught proper conduct — that a person should not teach his household members meat and wine," etc. But even though the foods of Eretz Yisrael are very fine and spiritual — because they are influenced by the Holy One Blessed be He Himself — as our Sages said — even so: "living things shall dwell in it" — see Metzudas Dovid [Tehillim 68] — and our Sages expounded [Eruvin 54]: "if a person makes himself like this animal that tramples and eats — and some say: that lets things rot and eats — his Torah endures in his hand," etc. And this is: "prepare through Your goodness for the poor."

 The sect that said it is fitting that beauty reign — because through this the settlement of the world increases — as it is written: "not for waste did He create it — for dwelling He fashioned it." And the primary is that the world be settled by people of complete faith and true knowledge — as is explained elsewhere. This being the aspect of the greatness of the mitzvah that the settlement of Eretz Yisrael should increase — as our Sages said. And there is the primary holy beauty — as it is written: "from Tzion — the perfection of beauty" — and it is written: "beautiful in loftiness," etc. — and: "the crown of beauty," etc. — and our Sages said: "ten kabbin of beauty descended to the world — nine were taken by Yerushalayim." And the general sanctity of Eretz Yisrael is in the aspect of Rachel — as is known — this being the aspect of: "and Rachel was beautiful of form," etc. — the aspect of: "ulimsa shapira" [a beautiful world], etc. — as is known. And the holy beauty flows from the aspect of: "and the light of Your face — for You favored them" — which is the aspect of radiance of the face — which depends primarily on the guarding of the bris and the nullification of that desire. As it is written: "strength and beauty are before Him — strength and joy are in His place." As is understood in the discourse Retzitzu — Likutay Moharan Kama, Siman 27. And this is what is written: "do not covet her beauty in your heart," etc. — and: "and you trusted in your beauty," etc. — and: "and you defiled your beauty," etc. — and it is said: "charm is deceitful and beauty is vain — a woman who fears Hashem — she shall be praised" — the aspect of the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — which is the aspect of: "a woman who fears Hashem" — as stated above many times. And this is the aspect of the daughter of the Queen — who subsequently reigned over the aforementioned sect.

The sect that said the primary purpose is speech, etc. — this flows from Moshe — and in holiness certainly speech is very precious — for the Tzaddikim are "mighty in strength — who do His word" — who conduct and lead the people through speech as they wish — as is explained in Likutay Moharan Tanina, Siman 60 — the discourse of the days of Chanukah. And the Tzaddikim have the power to create worlds through their speech — as our Sages said — and as is brought in the holy Zohar: "mah ana avdei shemaya ve-ar'a be-miluli" [what I made — heaven and earth — through My word], etc. And the primary perfection of speech is the aspect of the speech of the holy tongue. As is explained in the aforementioned discourse — and in the discourse Tefillah le-Chavakuk — Likutay Moharan Kama, Siman 19. And the primary perfection of the speech of the holy tongue is in Eretz Yisrael — as stated above many times. But the aforementioned sect erred as they erred — and they were subsequently rectified through the acceptance of the wondrous interpreter of the King — who was able to speak and interpret with wondrous songs and praises to the King. This being the primary perfection of speech.

 The sect that said the primary purpose is joy, etc. — this flows from the fact that in holiness in truth the primary perfection is to serve Hashem in perpetual joy — as it is written: "because you did not serve," etc., "in joy," etc. And as is brought in the name of the Ari of blessed memory — and as is explained greatly from the words of our Rebbe, may his memory be for blessing — and in the books of Likutay Halachos. And the holy joy is bound up and included with holy love — as it is written: "and those who love Your Name shall exult in You." And the primary perfection of joy is in Eretz Yisrael — and in particular in Yerushalayim — as it is written: "joy and gladness shall be found in her," etc. — and it is written: "Mount Tzion shall rejoice — the daughters of Yehudah shall be glad" — and it is written: "Israel shall rejoice in its Maker — the children of Tzion shall exult in their King" — and many more verses like these — and as stated above many times. But the aforementioned sect erred into the joy of licentiousness and drunkenness, G-d forbid — and they were subsequently rectified through the loyal friend of the interpreter being king over them. For this is the primary joy — to rejoice with the joy of a mitzvah — and to serve Hashem in joy. And in particular one who has merited to dwell in Eretz Yisrael — must rejoice greatly in the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — and even though now she is in her destruction, in our many sins — one must receive with joy the consolations that the Holy One Blessed be He consoles us through His prophets and holy Tzaddikim — and believe in truth — and await salvation at every moment — until we merit to see in truth her joy. And even now one must draw upon oneself at every moment joy from the aspect of the future joy. For the primary purpose is wisdom. This flows from the fact that in holiness certainly wisdom is very precious — as is explained in many verses. But they erred through this into external wisdoms and heresy, G-d forbid. And in truth the primary perfection of wisdom is the holy wisdom — founded on the foundation of the Torah and the holy faith — this being the aspect of the perfection of wisdom that is in Eretz Yisrael. As our Sages said [Kiddushin 49]: "ten kabbin of wisdom descended to the world — nine were taken by Eretz Yisrael." And Rashi explained: "wisdom — Torah and worldly conduct." (And see in Likutay Moharan Tanina, Siman 78 — regarding Torah and worldly conduct — which has relevance to Eretz Yisrael — and it has already been explained above.) And our Sages said: "there is no wisdom like the wisdom of Eretz Yisrael — and there is no Torah like the Torah of Eretz Yisrael." And the aforementioned sect too was subsequently rectified through the wise man of the King.

 The sect that said the primary purpose is to tend to growing the limbs through eating and drinking, etc. — this flows from the fact that in holiness the eating of the Tzaddikim and the servants of G-d is certainly very precious — and it is like sacrifices in every respect. And our Sages said regarding Yitzchak: "if for your sacrifice the Holy One Blessed be He provided for you — for your food — all the more so." And similarly the growing of limbs in holiness is certainly also a great thing — and the Sanhedrin were required to be men of stature — and Moshe Rabbainu, may peace be upon him, his height was ten cubits — and similarly regarding Avraham our father it is said: "the great man among the Anakim" — and our Sages greatly elaborated on the greatness of his height. And regarding Yaakov our father they said that his two hands were like two pillars of marble. And regarding Shaul it is said: "from his shoulders and above — taller than all the people." And our Sages greatly elaborated regarding various great men of Israel — in the greatness of the height of their stature and the greatness of their strength and might. For in holiness it is certainly a great thing — and our Sages said: "the Shechinah does not rest except on one who is wise, strong, and wealthy." And the primary perfection of holy might is in Eretz Yisrael — as is explained in the words of our Sages — from the greatness of their might. And similarly there is the perfection of holy eating — as stated above many times. And the aforementioned sect too was subsequently rectified through the warrior of the King.

The sect that said the primary purpose is wealth — this flows from the fact that in holiness wealth is certainly very precious — and as our Sages said: "Rabbi honored the wealthy." For there are supernal colors in the holy silver and gold — as is explained greatly in the words of our Rebbe, may his memory be for blessing. But the aforementioned sect erred greatly through this — into the desire for money — until they came to literal idolatry, G-d forbid. As is explained in Likutay Moharan Kama, Siman 23 — that the desire for money is literally the aspect of idolatry — and is comprised of all the idolatries of all seventy nations. And therefore the primary perfection of holy wealth is in Eretz Yisrael — where one merits the nullification of the desire for money — as stated above many times. And there is the primary perfection of tzedakah — the aspect of: "and righteousness in the orchard shall dwell" — through which one merits to break the desire for money — as is explained in Likutay Moharan Kama, Siman 23. And the aforementioned sect too was subsequently rectified through the one appointed over the treasuries who was with the King.

 But the primary rectification of all the aforementioned sects was through the Baal Tefillah — who merited to reign over the sect that said the primary purpose is only to engage in prayer and songs and praises to the Holy One Blessed be He — and to be humble and low in spirit, etc. — and similarly everything they merited to find and gather — all the holy gathering of the King and his men — all was in the merit of the worthy Baal Tefillah and in the merit of his holy prayers — as is explained within the ma'amar. For prayer is comprised of all the aforementioned aspects in holiness — for it is the aspect of honor — the aspect of: "give honor to His praise" — as is explained in Likutay Moharan Kama, Siman 2 — the discourse Emor el ha-Kohanim. And as it is written: "he shall call upon Me in the day of trouble — I will release him — and he shall honor Me" — and it is written: "he shall call upon Me and I will answer him — I am with him in trouble — I will release him and honor him." And even though the primary of prayer is mercy and supplication — even so it is comprised also of the trait of judgment — this being the aspect of what sometimes one must pray a prayer in the aspect of judgment — the aspect of: "and he interceded — who made intercession for his Creator" — and as is explained in Likutay Tanina, Siman 8 — the discourse Tiku Tochachah. And see in Likutay Moharan Kama, Siman 80 — the discourse Hashem oz le-amo yiten — that prayer must be with self-sacrifice — which is the aspect of the might of the trait of judgment. And similarly the primary downfall of the nations — in the aspect of: "de-achli kola ve-shatzei kola" — as stated above — is through prayer. And similarly through prayer in fullness the killing and destruction is nullified from the world — as is understood in the discourse Mechiyyas Kapayim — Likutay Moharan Kama, Siman 44. And anger is nullified — as is understood in the Sefer HaMidos, the letter of Hisbodedus. And similarly prayer is the aspect of fine and spiritual food — as it is written: "like fat and richness shall my soul be satisfied — and with lips of joyful song shall my mouth praise." And similarly prayer is the aspect of: "a woman who fears Hashem" — which is the opposite of the aspect of: "beauty is vain." And also through prayer one merits children — as it is written: "and Yitzchak pleaded," etc., "and Hashem granted his plea." And similarly prayer is the aspect of the perfection of speech — the aspect of: "Hashem, open my lips," etc. — and it is written: "who creates the expression of the lips," etc. — and our Sages expounded: "if his prayer is fluent in his mouth." And also through prayer in fullness one merits joy — as is explained in Likutay Moharan Kama, Siman 5 — the discourse ba-chatzotzerot — and in Siman 22 — the discourse chotem besoch chotem. And similarly the primary perfection of prayer is when it is in joy — as is explained elsewhere — and as our Sages said [Berachos 31]: "one does not stand to pray", etc., "except from joy of a mitzvah." And also the primary spring of wisdom flows from the aspect of prayer — as is explained in Likutay Moharan Kama, Siman 8 — the discourse Ra'isi Menoras Zahav. And also through the perfection of prayer the limbs grow and the bones are enriched — the aspect of: "and good tidings enrich the bone" — as is explained in Likutay Moharan Kama, Siman 50 — the discourse Hatzilah me-Cherev. And also prayer is the aspect of the one appointed over the treasuries — the aspect of holy wealth — for all the good influences flow only through Israel. And also through prayer in fullness one merits the perfection of prayer with even greater fullness every time — for there is perfection beyond perfection in the matter of prayer. And one must merit such a perfect prayer — until the prayer is one unity with Him, blessed be He — the aspect of: "He is your praise and He is your G-d." As is explained in Siman 19 of Likutay Tanina — and as is explained further regarding the perfection of prayer in Likutay Moharan, Siman 22 — the discourse chotem besoch chotem as mentioned above. And the primary perfection of prayer is in Eretz Yisrael — as stated above many times.

 It follows that all the ten aforementioned matters — which in their supernal sanctity are the aspect of the world of Tikkun — all are included in the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael. And there is the sanctity of the aspect of the foods — through which one comes to disgust money — as is explained in the allusions — this being the aspect of: "whose fire is in Tzion," etc. — as stated above. And see in Likutay Halachos — Laws of Prayer — as mentioned above. (And see Bava Basra 122 — "if one says: for beauty — do you think we are dealing with fools?" — and Rashi explained: those who withdraw from their inheritance for money, etc. — meaning: there they come to disgust money.)

 
 Story 13 · סימן י"ג — מַעֲשֶׂה מֵהַשִּׁבְעָה בַּעֲטְלֵּרְס

The Seven Beggars

 The primary of old age and long life one merits in Eretz Yisrael — as it is written: "in order that you lengthen days upon the land," etc. — and it is written: "and you shall dwell long in the land that you shall inherit" — and similarly many more. And as our Sages said [Berachos 8]: "there are old people in Babylon — he was astounded — he said: 'in order that your days may be multiplied,' etc. — 'on the land' is written," etc. And there is the primary holy memory — as stated above many times. And there is the primary point of Creation — as it is written: "from Tzion — the perfection of beauty," etc. — and as our Sages expounded that Eretz Yisrael was created first — and in particular the Bais HaMikdash — as our Sages said. And therefore there one can merit a holy memory so great — until one remembers everything that happened to all of Creation — from the beginning of Atzilus — the aspect of the soul — as it is written: "who gives a soul to the people upon it," etc. — until the Creation went from potential to actual deed. This being the aspect of the cutting of the navel. For Yerushalayim is the navel of the earth — as is brought. And also there one can merit an even greater additional virtue — until one is included in the aspect of Ein Sof [the Infinite] literally. This being the aspect of what the blind one boasted — that he remembers nothing at all. Meaning: he remembers even what is before nefesh-ruach-neshamah — which is the aspect of ayin [nothingness] — as is explained within the ma'amar. And see Rashi on Shir HaShirim — on the verse: "your navel is a rounded goblet," etc.

 And similarly there in Eretz Yisrael one merits a good life that has no deficiency — as it is written: "it lacks nothing" — and as it is written: "in order that you live and it be good for you," etc., "in the land that you shall inherit" — and it is written: "to see the goodness of Hashem in the land of the living." And similarly there is the primary perfection of wisdom — for: "there is no wisdom like the wisdom of Eretz Yisrael." And similarly there is the primary perfection of riddles and songs — the aspect of: "sing to us from the songs of Tzion" — the aspect of the song that the Levites would say in the Bais HaMikdash — the aspect of Shir HaShirim — said when Shlomoh built the Bais HaMikdash. And there is the primary holy longing and yearning — the aspect of: "my soul thirsts for You," etc., "so in the sanctuary I have beheld You — to see Your might and Your glory" — and it is written: "my soul has longed — indeed it has pined — for the courts of Hashem," etc. And there is the primary true lovingkindness — the aspect of what they said to Rachav: "and it shall be when Hashem gives us the land — and we will do with you lovingkindness and truth." For all the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael is in the aspect of lovingkindness and truth — as it is written: "grant truth to Yaakov — lovingkindness to Avraham — which You swore to our fathers from ancient days." And it is said [Tehillim 85]: "You desired, Hashem, Your land," etc., "yet close to those who fear Him is His salvation — for glory to dwell in our land — lovingkindness and truth have met," etc. — see there in the commentators.

And because the primary formation of time is through true lovingkindness — and this is the aspect of: "to tell in the morning of Your lovingkindness," etc. — and its Targum: "ve-kushtech be-leilavan" — for from there is the primary formation of time — therefore the primary reckoning of time — according to the sunrise and sunset — is in Eretz Yisrael — and in particular in Yerushalayim — as is brought. And there is the aspect of the heart — for the Bais HaMikdash is the heart of the world — as our Sages said — and therefore it is entirely called the name of Dovid — as it is written: "see your house, O Dovid" — and as our Sages said — for Dovid is the aspect of the heart — (and therefore there is no sitting in the Azarah except for the kings of the house of Dovid). And this is: "and My eyes and My heart shall be there." And there is the aspect of the spring — the aspect of: "and a spring shall flow from the house of Hashem." And there is the aspect of the bird that spreads its wings over the heart, etc. — as it is written: "and the Keruvim shall be spreading wings upward — screening with their wings over the kappores" — "da kappurta de-liba" [this is the covering of the heart]. And because the riddles and songs change according to the changes in the days — therefore the Levites would say a different song each day — and in particular on Shabbos and Rosh Chodesh and Yom Tov. And in these riddles and songs — all the wisdoms are included, etc. And this is the aspect of: "mizmor maskil" [a psalm of contemplation]. And this is what is written [Divray HaYomim II 30]: "and Chizkiyahu spoke to the heart of all the Levites — who gave good insight for Hashem" — and Rashi explained: "regarding song — the language of insight applies."

 And there is the primary perfection of the speech of praises to the Holy One Blessed be He — the aspect of: "praise Hashem, O Yerushalayim" — and many like it. But now she is in the aspect of being of heavy tongue — the aspect of: "I was mute — silent", etc. — the aspect of: "and like a ewe before her shearers — she is silent." But in the future it is written: "so that my glory may sing to You and not be silent." And similarly the Bais HaMikdash is the aspect of a neck — as it is written: "and he fell upon Binyamin's brother's neck and wept" — and Rashi explained: "over the two sanctuaries," etc. And there is the primary perfection of holy melody — the aspect of the ten types of melody — and there is the primary perfection of the voice — the aspect of: "and He heard the voice speaking to him," etc. — and it is written [Divray HaYomim II 5]: "and it was as one — for the trumpeters and the singers — to make one voice — to praise and give thanks to Hashem — and to raise the voice," etc., "and the house was filled with the cloud — the house of Hashem," etc. — see there. And there is the primary joining of the Keruvim — the aspect of: "and their faces — man toward his brother," etc. And there is the aspect of the throwing of voices — as is explained in Likutay Halachos, Laws of Vows, halachah 4 — see there.

 And similarly the Bais HaMikdash is the aspect of the little that contains the much — as our Sages said: "they stood crowded but bowed down with space." And regarding Yerushalayim they said: "no one ever said to his friend: the place is too narrow for me to lodge in Yerushalayim." And it is written: "and many nations shall gather to it," etc. — and our Sages said: for the little contains the much. And regarding all of Eretz Yisrael our Sages said [Kesuvos 112]: "why was Eretz Yisrael compared to a deer? Just as the deer — its skin does not contain its flesh — so too Eretz Yisrael does not contain its fruits." And also through it all the praises and requests of all the world ascend — and for this there is needed the aspect of speech — which is the little that contains the much — as is explained within the ma'amar. (And see also in Shivchay HaRan, Siman 175 — regarding andansenia [audience].)

And also there is the aspect of silence — which is the aspect of the little that contains the much — this being the aspect of: "and Calev silenced the people toward Moshe" — for he wanted to draw upon them the aforementioned aspect of silence — through which all the slanders and accusations of the spies — the spreaders of slander about the land — would be nullified. And this is: "and Yehoshua sent two men as spies — charesh" — from the language of silence — as stated above. And also there is the aspect of speech — which is the little that contains the much — for there is the perfection of the speech of the holy tongue — as stated above many times — and the speech of the holy tongue is the aspect of the little that contains the much. For in every word and word — great secrets and many wondrous matters are included — as is known — and somewhat understood from the mystical intentions of the Ari, of blessed memory, on the words of the prayers, etc. And the primary perfection of prayer is in Eretz Yisrael — as stated above many times. And also there is the aspect of silence — which is the little that contains the much — for there is the perfection of wisdom — as stated above many times. And: "the fence of wisdom is silence" — and it is written: "for You silence is praise, O G-d, in Tzion," etc. — (and see Eruvin 19 — what our Sages expounded on this verse). And it is written: "He suspends the earth on nothingness" — and our Sages expounded [Chullin 89]: "over one who silences himself," etc. — and it is written: "and the earth is the footstool of My feet" — from the language of silence and stillness — as is brought elsewhere.

 And also there is the aspect of the one who conducts and leads the wheel of the moon — as it is written: "He made the moon for appointed times" — and it is written: "these are the appointed times of Hashem that you shall call them" — do not read osam [them] but atem [you] — and the primary fixing of the month and the appointed times depends specifically on the dwellers of Eretz Yisrael — as our Sages said. This being the aspect of the secret of intercalation — which is specifically in Eretz Yisrael. And see in Likutay Moharan Kama, Siman 61 — the discourse of Rabbi Shimon. And the first conquest of Eretz Yisrael — Yericho — is named after the moon — which is its constellation — as is brought. And there one merits to come to the sanctity of the holy tree — which has three roots: emunah — humility — and awe. And truth is the trunk of the tree — and all these traits are included in the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael — many times. And there one merits to ascend from the aspect of place — to the aspect of entirely above place — for through it all souls ascend to the lower Gan Eden — and from there to the upper Gan Eden — and so further and further upward, etc. — as is explained in the holy Zohar.

 And also there is the primary healing of the daughter of the King — through the power of the holy hands — as it is written: "Your hand — You drove out the nations," etc. — and it is written: "to the land that I lifted My hand," etc. And this is the aspect of [Divray HaYomim II 7]: "and I will forgive their sin — and I will heal their land" — and it is written [Yeshayahu 30]: "on the day that Hashem binds up the breach of His people — and heals the blow of His wound." This being the aspect of what one can retract and draw out even the arrows — even after they were shot — the aspect of: "He set me up and made me a target for the arrow." Even so it is said: "I put to death and I revive — I have struck and I will heal." And one can also say that the ten Canaanite nations — that Eretz Yisrael was initially in their hands — and they defiled it — and blemished its sanctity — these are the aspects of the ten types of arrows that were shot into the daughter of the King — and afterwards the arrows were removed from her — and Israel inherited their land. And this is what is said regarding the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael in Parshas Balak: "he shall devour the nations his enemies — and he shall crush their bones — and his arrows shall shatter" — and Onkelos translated: "ve-ar'as-hon yechasinun" [and their lands they shall inherit]. And also there is the primary perfection of tzedakah — as it is written: "and righteousness in the orchard shall dwell" — as stated above many times. And in Eretz Yisrael it is said: "for He founded it upon the seas," etc. And perhaps this flows and is derived from the aspect of the secret of the water fortress as is explained within the ma'amar. And also there is the primary perfection of wisdom — for ten kabbin of wisdom descended to the world — nine were taken by Eretz Yisrael, etc. And there is the primary ordination of the wise men — as our Sages said — and as is brought above. And there is the totality of all ten types of melody — as stated above many times. And therefore there is the primary healing of the daughter of the King, as stated above.

Story 14 · סימן י"ד — מַעֲשֶׂה מֵהַמְּנוֹרָה

 The Menorah

 Eretz Yisrael is very very good — in the ultimate perfection — without any deficiency — as it is written: "it lacks nothing." And it is called a desirable land — good and broad — the inheritance of the deer — the desire of all nations — for all the wicked kings of the nations were desirous and longing for it. And what sometimes appears to someone therein as some deficiency, G-d forbid — let him know that this is only from the deficiency of his knowledge — that he does not recognize her goodness. And similarly our Sages said in Sifrei: "a land of mountains and valleys — do you think it speaks of her disparagement? It speaks only of her praise," etc. And like what our Sages said regarding the verse: "a land that devours its inhabitants" — "the Holy One Blessed be He said: I intended it for good," etc. And this is the aspect of: "all ascend to Eretz Yisrael" — meaning: there are there no deficiencies — only all are ascents — good and holy and wondrous. And this is the aspect of what our Sages said: "Eretz Yisrael is higher than all the lands" — meaning: she is higher also in her quality — that she is more praised in good virtues than all the lands. And this is the aspect of: "and He will establish it on high." And this is what our Sages said [Midrash Rabbah Vayikra, chapter 24]: "may He send your help from the sanctuary", etc. — "all good things and blessings and consolations", etc., "are only from Tzion," etc. — see there. And our Sages said: "why is she called tevel? Because she is seasoned from all the lands — for every land — what this one has — that one lacks — but Eretz Yisrael lacks nothing — as it is said: 'it lacks nothing,'" etc. (And see Sha'ar HaChatzair — the Gate — in the name of the commentators, of blessed memory, who explained: "Yerushalayim that is built — like a city that is joined together within it" — meaning: like a city into whose building all the craftsmen of the world were gathered — so that certainly there is no deficiency in it — for what was lacking from this craftsman — this craftsman revealed and rectified — this is directed toward our aforementioned matter.)

שִׂיחוֹת הָרַ"ן · Sichot HaRan

 
 Sichot HaRan, Siman 32 · סימן ל"ב

 Tzarich Lechazek Atzmo Be-Emunah — "One Must Strengthen Oneself in Faith"

The primary of faith in its fullness is in Eretz Yisrael — as stated above many times. And there the faith is in simplicity — without any investigations and wisdoms at all — only in straightforwardness and simplicity — as it is written: "for the upright shall dwell in the land — and the wholehearted shall remain in it" — as stated above many times. And through this one merits there to the aspect of will — which is above even wisdom — meaning: one yearns for the Holy One Blessed be He with wondrous will and intense longing. This being the aspect of: "my soul has longed — indeed it has pined — for the courts of Hashem." And therefore it is called a desirable land [eretz chemdah] — for there the holy will and desire shines most greatly — the aspect of: "in his shade I desired and I sat," etc. And the illumination of this will flows from the aspect of pele [wonder] — which is above even the aspect of wisdom — as is known. And this is: "I will thank Your Name — for You have done wondrously — counsels from afar — faithful and sure" — and it is said: "and the heavens shall thank Your wondrous acts, Hashem — yes — Your faithfulness," etc. And this is: "and Your faithfulness round about you" — for it is the aspect of makifin [encircling lights] — as is explained in Likutay Tanina, Siman 7 — the discourse Ki Merachamam. And this is the aspect of Amon mufla — as is explained in Likutay Moharan Kama, Siman 24 — the discourse amtza'ita de-alma. And therefore Eretz Yisrael is called Eretz HaChayyim — for the illumination of the will — the aforementioned aspect of makifin — is the aspect of the light of the face — as it is written: "and the light of Your face — for You favored them" — (and this verse is said regarding the very matter of the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael itself) — and: "in the light of the face of the King — life."

 And also because through faith one lives — strong and powerful life — as is explained within the ma'amar — and as it is written: "Hashem — the strength of my life," etc. And this is the aspect of: "and the righteous one shall live through his faith." And also there they offer the sacrifices in shame and with a broken heart — as is explained in the holy Zohar — and through this the meditations and investigations that are in a person's heart are broken — and one merits to faith — which is the aspect of: as Yerushalayim — a faithful city. And this is: "for You do not desire sacrifice," etc., "the sacrifices of G-d are a broken spirit — a broken and contrite heart," etc., "do good in Your will to Tzion," etc. — and as our Sages said: "Hashem builds Yerushalayim — He gathers the scattered of Israel — the Healer of the broken-hearted," etc.

 
 Sichot HaRan, Siman 40 (first part) · סימן מ'

Be-Inyan Sifray HaMechkarim — "Regarding the Books of Investigation"

 It has already been explained many times that Eretz Yisrael is the aspect of emunah — and emunah means: to know and believe that all the worlds emanated and were created and formed and made from nothing into something — and in their root everything is one, etc. — this being the aspect of the revolving wheel — as is explained within the ma'amar. And therefore the first place they entered upon entering Eretz Yisrael — they called its name Gilgal [rolling / revolving] — as it is written [Yehoshua 5]: "and he called the name of that place Gilgal," etc. And even though it is explained there that it was named thus for the sake of: "today I have rolled away the shame of Egypt," etc. — the commentators have already explained that this means: the corrupted beliefs that were in Egypt. And according to our approach — one can say that the investigations and external wisdoms — founded upon the conduct of nature — and who deny the Providence of His will, blessed be He — and hold that everything is conducted only according to the scheme of the constellations — are the aspect of shame — the aspect of: "for he has shamed the formations of the living G-d" — said of Goliath — as is understood in Likutay Tanina, Siman 4 — the discourse ve-es ha-ORavim. And also because the aforementioned external wisdoms come from the aspect of surpluses and dross, etc. — as is explained in Likutay Moharan Kama, Siman 64 — the discourse bo el Paro. And surpluses are the aspect of orlah — which is the aspect of shame — as it is written: "for it is a shame to us." And this is the aspect of the shame of Egypt. For Egypt trusted in itself — in the power of their constellation — which is the first of the twelve constellations. And the Holy One Blessed be He overturned nature — and nullified the scheme of the constellations — and showed them the aspect of the revolving wheel — in which higher ones descend below and lower ones ascend above.

 And this is what is placed adjacent to it: "and the children of Israel camped in Gilgal — and they made the Passover," etc. For all the matter of the Passover sacrifice teaches this — as is known. And therefore for all fourteen years of the conquest and division of Eretz Yisrael — the Mishkan — which is also the Bais HaMikdash — stood in Gilgal — as is explained in Zevachim and in the Rambam [Laws of the Temple, chapter 1]. For the primary aspect of the revolving wheel as stated above is in the Bais HaMikdash — as is explained within the ma'amar. And therefore when Israel blemished regarding the inheritance of Eretz Yisrael — it is said [Shoftim 2]: "and an angel of Hashem ascended from Gilgal — specifically — to the weeping ones — and he rebuked them for this." And because the beginning of the going out of Creation from potential to actual was through the aspect of hyuli [prime matter] — which is the aspect of wisdom — as is explained within the ma'amar — and Eretz Yisrael is the primary point of Creation — as stated above many times — therefore the air of Eretz Yisrael makes one wise. And there the other three aspects are also included — which are: angels — spheres — lower ones — meaning: human beings. Therefore at the beginning of the conquest of Eretz Yisrael it is said: "and it was when Yehoshua was in Yericho," etc., "for I am the commander of the army of Hashem — now I have come." Meaning: the angel who came to help them in the war. And similarly many times — as it is written: "and an angel of Hashem went out and struck in the camp of Ashur." And in the war of Sisera it is written: "from the heavens they fought — the stars," etc. Meaning: the stars of the aforementioned spheres. And the victory of the war itself was between the lower human beings — where Israel fought with the nations and conquered them. And all these aforementioned were in their assistance — meaning: the aspects of hyuli — separate — sphere — lower one — as is explained within the ma'amar. And all of this was only the one simple power and will of His blessed being — from Whom, blessed be He, is the root of everything. This being the aspect of: the wheel is the one that revolves in the world — which was revealed through the sanctity of Eretz Yisrael and the Bais HaMikdash, as stated above.

Sichot HaRan, Siman 40 (second part) · סימן מ' המשך

 Ben Zoma — Ben Nannas — Ben Pazi

 And with this one can explain somewhat the words of the Midrash — brought by the compiler in the introduction to Ein Yaakov — and this is its language: "Ben Zomah says: we have found a more comprehensive verse — and it is: 'Hear, O Israel,' etc. Ben Nannas says: we have found a more comprehensive verse — and it is: 'and you shall love your neighbor as yourself.' Ben Pazi says: we have found a more comprehensive verse — and it is: 'the one lamb you shall make in the morning,' etc. Rabbi So-and-so stood on his feet and said: the law follows Ben Pazi — as it is written: 'according to all that I show you — the form of the Tabernacle,' etc." — see there what the compiler explained regarding this. And according to the above — it is somewhat explained. For this matter of the aspect of the revolving wheel — meaning: to believe that in the root — everything is one, etc. — as is explained within the ma'amar — this is the foundation of all the Torah. For through this one believes that some sin and blemish of a lowly human being damages, as it were, in all the worlds — and causes evil to himself and others, G-d forbid. And so too conversely — for some mitzvah and good thing causes rectification in all the worlds — and draws great good things to himself and to all the world — as our Sages said. Which is not so according to the view of the wise men of nature — who say everything is fixed in its place and on the basis of the conduct of nature, G-d forbid. This contradicts all the principles of our holy Torah, G-d forbid.

And therefore Ben Zomah said that the verse Shema Yisrael — in which the faith of unity is explained — is the most comprehensive of all the Torah — as stated above. And Ben Nannas says: we have found a more comprehensive verse — and it is: ve-ahavta le-re'acha kamokha. For at first glance — how is it possible to fulfill this? For a person is close to himself — and how is it possible to love his fellow exactly like himself? But because in truth in the root everything is one — (except for the nations and the Sitra Achra — who separate and detach themselves from the unity. And even in this — there is no way to explain fully — according to the way of the verse: "for in every place — incense is burned and offered to My Name," etc. — and therefore in truth it is written: "for then I will change toward all the peoples," etc., "to call all of them in the Name of Hashem") — but the souls of Israel are truly all included in His simple unity, blessed be He — until through this one merits true love of Hashem — and also true love of companions. Until they are in the aspect of complete unity. For: "love" in numerical value equals echad [one] — as is brought. And through this itself — His simple unity, blessed be He, is also revealed above — the aspect of: "You are one and Your Name is one — and who is like Your people Israel — one nation in the land." And as is explained in Likutay Moharan Tanina, Siman 2 — the discourse of the days of Chanukah. And therefore this verse is the most comprehensive. For this is seen in sensory experience more — and they draw the aspect of the faith of unity into practice as well — through deeds and traits. And through this the simple unity of His blessed being is revealed automatically. And this is: "and you shall love your neighbor as yourself — I am Hashem" — the simple One, blessed be He — who brings all existences into being.

 Ben Pazi says: we have found a more comprehensive verse — and it is: "the one lamb you shall make in the morning," etc. For from this verse it is understood that the simple unity, blessed be He, surrounds and includes even the very lowest levels — as it were — even animals — until the human being is included with the animal in holiness — in one supernal unity. And when they offer the animal — it is as if the human being himself is offered. The aspect of: "when a man from among you brings a sacrifice to Hashem — from the animals," etc. — as our Sages said. And the sacrifice is a fire-offering — a pleasing aroma to Hashem — and ascends and returns and is included — up and up — as it were. And as is explained in the holy Zohar — the greatness of the rectifications made on high through the sacrifices — and in particular the daily burnt-offering. And in this is precise the language: "the one lamb." And our Sages were precise: if it says "lamb" — why does it say "one"? But this is to allude that the wheel is the one that revolves in the world — and in the root everything is one unity — as stated above. And this is like what our Sages expounded: "and there was evening and there was morning — one day." And Rashi explained: "according to the order of the language of the portion — it should have written 'the first day,' etc. — why does it write 'one'? Because the Holy One Blessed be He was alone in His world" — as stated above. For even light and darkness — which are apparently two complete opposites — everything is from the simple One, blessed be He. And therefore it is written in the future: "and there shall be one day — known to Hashem — neither day nor night" — and it is written: "and it shall be at evening time — there shall be light" — the aspect of the revolving wheel, as stated above.

 Rabbi So-and-so stood on his feet and said: the law follows Ben Pazi — as it is written: "according to all that I show you — the form of the Tabernacle," etc. Meaning: that the Holy One Blessed be He showed Moshe Rabbainu, may peace be upon him, the upper Tabernacle with all its orientations — and even so He left it aside and caused His Shechinah, as it were, to rest in the lower Tabernacle — and as our Sages expounded. For because below they can err, G-d forbid — like the view of the wise men of nature, G-d forbid — and be separated from His simple unity, blessed be He — therefore the Holy One Blessed be He showed Moshe in actual sensory experience — the aspect of higher ones below and lower ones above — which was the primary matter in the Bais HaMikdash and the Tabernacle. And this is: "and they shall make for Me a sanctuary — and I will dwell in their midst — according to all that I show you — the form of the Tabernacle," etc. And also because since one must make the lower Tabernacle literally like the form of the upper Tabernacle — it is shown in sensory experience that everything is one unity — for Hashem is G-d in the heavens above and on the earth below — there is no other — only His unity, blessed be He, includes everything. And also because the form of the Tabernacle is like the form of the act of Creation — as is explained in the holy Zohar. It follows that when the Holy One Blessed be He showed Moshe the form of the upper Tabernacle — He showed him the form of all of the act of Creation in its roots — and commanded him to make the Tabernacle like this form. And in the Tabernacle it is written: "and the Tabernacle shall be one." For all the acts of Creation are included in one unity — the aspect of: the wheel is the one that revolves — as stated above — which is the all-encompassing foundation of all the holy Torah, as stated above. (And it is automatically understood that it is impossible to elaborate further on this matter.)

 And close to the plain meaning — it seems most plausible to explain: for all these Tanna'im intended to explain from the Torah — how all Israel are literally the aspect of unity. And therefore Ben Zomah expounded from the verse Shema Yisrael Hashem Elokeinu Hashem Echad. And since the Holy One Blessed be He is one — and we have merited to receive upon ourselves His G-dliness, blessed be He — and to believe in His unity, blessed be He — this being the aspect of: "Hashem our G-d — specifically — Hashem is one" — through this all Israel are included as one in true unity. Which is itself also included in the words Shema Yisrael — for they awaken and include all Israel together for this matter — to accept upon ourselves the faith of unity. And this too is shema — from the language of gathering and assembly — as in: "and Shaul heard," etc. — as is brought. Ben Nannas says: ve-ahavta le-re'acha kamokha is the most comprehensive. For here the unity of Israel is seen in actual practice — through deed and through traits. Ben Pazi says: "the one lamb" is the most comprehensive. For the verse is careful intentionally in the word one — to indicate that all Israel are one actual unity. And they offer each day a daily burnt-offering on behalf of all Israel — one lamb in the morning — and the second between the evenings — and they atone for all Israel — as our Sages said — and from this it is clear that they are all one unity literally. Rabbi So-and-so stood on his feet and said: the law follows Ben Pazi — as it is written: "and they shall make for Me a sanctuary — and I will dwell in their midst — not in its midst is written — but in their midst." Teaching that the Holy One Blessed be He causes His Shechinah to rest within the heart of every single one of Israel. And immediately following this verse it is written: "according to all that I show you," etc. And from this it appears that just as the Tabernacle — of which it is said: "and the Tabernacle shall be one" — even though it was divided into boards and sockets and curtains and vessels — all of it was one unity — and a preparation for the dwelling of His Shechinah, blessed be He — so too all Israel — even though they are divided in their bodies — and the Holy One Blessed be He causes His Shechinah to rest within the heart of each one — but all of them are one actual unity. And the totality of all of them is in the aspect of the Tabernacle — where His Shechinah, blessed be He, dwells — the aspect of: "and I will dwell in their midst," as stated above.

And the general intention of the aforementioned Tanna'im seems to be — that they came to resolve what the Holy One Blessed be He merited Israel with — six hundred and thirteen mitzvos — and among the mitzvos — there are many that not every person can fulfill — such as the mitzvos of the priesthood and Levites — the firstborn — yibbum — and further similar — as the early ones, of blessed memory, were precise about this matter. Therefore Ben Zomah expounded: since all your mitzvos are faith — it follows that the foundation of all the Torah is the faith of unity.
